appDescription: A driving coach app for new drivers that teaches car features, parking and steering, and practice driving routes using real vehicle signals.

function.name: LEARN_CAR_FEATURE
function.description: Open the step-by-step practice that teaches how to use a control or feature of this car.

featureName.description: Name of the car control or feature the driver wants to learn, as the driver said it.

function.name: START_PARKING_PRACTICE
function.description: Start the interactive 3D parking and steering practice, which is available only while the car is parked.

function.name: START_PRACTICE_COURSE
function.description: Create a short practice driving course around the current location and prepare it for route guidance.
